observed_feedback: The repository requires assignment before a pull request.
The repository requires the contributor to write person-to-person Issue comments in their own words.
The five-role quorum denied the exact agent-authored draft and required human action.
scout_learning: Discovery ACTIONABLE_NOW means a public entry exists; it does not mean an agent may author the required communication.
Repository-specific authorship policy must be applied after discovery and before external action.
Exact source, slice, body, and diff digests must bind an authorization; newline and file-vs-object digest ambiguity must fail closed.
A technical comment does not establish collaboration, acceptance, adoption, or revenue.
next_valid_step: A person may independently write a short scope-confirmation comment in their own words. That exact new body must receive a fresh digest, evidence capture, and quorum decision before posting.
